theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 43 群

items.colloc: bite the bullet 咬牙堅持 | take a bite 吃一口
items.distinct: chew 咀嚼 | sting 螫傷
ex: The office dog might bite if you approach quickly.
如果你靠近太快，辦公室的狗可能會咬人。
She took a quick bite of her sandwich during the meeting.
她在會議期間匆匆咬了一口三明治。
He had to bite his tongue to avoid arguing with the boss.
他不得不強忍住不去跟老闆爭辯。

items.pos: adj. 瞎的；盲目的 | v. 使失明
items.colloc: blind spot 盲點 | turn a blind eye 視而不見
items.distinct: deaf 聾的 | blurred 模糊的
ex: The team had a blind spot in their marketing strategy.
團隊在行銷策略上有個盲點。
Do not turn a blind eye to the safety violations.
不要對安全違規事項視而不見。
His lack of experience left him blind to the potential risks.
缺乏經驗使他看不見潛在風險。

items.pos: v. 打擾；煩擾 | n. 麻煩
items.colloc: bother to do something 費心做某事 | do not bother 不必費心
items.distinct: disturb 干擾 | annoy 惱怒
ex: I do not want to bother you with these minor issues.
我不想用這些小問題來打擾你。
Please do not bother to rewrite the entire report today.
請不必費心在今天重寫整份報告。
It is a lot of bother to move all the office equipment.
移動所有的辦公設備相當麻煩。

items.colloc: in celebration of 為了慶祝 | host a celebration 舉辦慶祝活動
items.distinct: ceremony 儀式 | festival 節日
ex: The company held a celebration for the successful product launch.
公司為成功發表新產品舉辦了慶祝活動。
We are planning a small celebration to mark the store opening.
我們正在規劃一場小小的慶祝會來紀念商店開幕。
The celebration will take place in the main conference hall.
慶祝活動將在主要會議廳舉行。

items.colloc: central office 總公司 | central location 中心位置
items.distinct: middle 中間的 | main 主要的
ex: Our central office is located in the heart of the city.
我們的總公司位於市中心。
Providing excellent service is central to our business philosophy.
提供優質服務是我們商業哲學的核心。
The hotel features a central location near the subway station.
這間飯店位於靠近地鐵站的中心地段。

items.pos: n. 挑戰 | v. 向……挑戰
items.colloc: face a challenge 面臨挑戰 | meet a challenge 迎接挑戰
items.distinct: difficulty 困難 | competition 競爭
ex: This project presents a significant challenge for our design team.
這個專案對我們的設計團隊來說是一項重大挑戰。
The management team challenged the accuracy of the financial report.
管理團隊質疑了這份財務報告的準確性。
Employees are encouraged to meet every challenge with confidence.
公司鼓勵員工充滿自信地迎接每一項挑戰。

items.colloc: head chemist 首席化學家 | chemist's shop 藥局
items.distinct: pharmacist 藥劑師（美式）| scientist 科學家
ex: The lead chemist developed a new formula for the detergent.
首席化學家為清潔劑研發了一種新配方。
He works as a chemist in a pharmaceutical research laboratory.
他在一家製藥研究實驗室擔任化學家。
You can consult the chemist about the side effects of this medicine.
你可以向藥劑師諮詢這種藥物的副作用。

items.pos: adj. 首要的 | n. 首領；主管
items.colloc: chief executive officer 執行長 | chief concern 主要關切事項
items.distinct: head 負責人 | principal 主要的
ex: Our chief priority this quarter is to increase total sales.
本季我們的首要任務是提升總銷售額。
The chief accountant will review the budget proposal tomorrow.
總會計師明天將審查預算提案。
Communication is our chief concern during the transition period.
溝通是我們過渡期間的主要關切事項。

items.colloc: clothing store 服飾店 | casual clothing 休閒服裝
items.distinct: clothes 衣服（複數）| garment 服裝（單件）
ex: The retailer specializes in high-quality professional clothing.
這家零售商專門銷售高品質的專業服裝。
Please donate your unwanted clothing to the local charity.
請將您不再需要的衣物捐贈給當地慈善機構。
The brand is launching a new line of winter clothing.
該品牌正在推出一系列冬季服飾。

items.pos: adj. 寒冷的；冷漠的 | n. 感冒
items.colloc: catch a cold 感冒 | cold reception 冷淡的回應
items.distinct: chilly 寒涼的 | freezing 極冷的
ex: The office was quite cold due to the broken heating system.
因為暖氣系統壞了，辦公室裡相當冷。
She received a cold reception after proposing the unpopular plan.
她在提出那個不受歡迎的計畫後，受到了冷淡的回應。
He took a sick leave because he caught a bad cold.
他因為得了重感冒而請病假。

items.colloc: communicate with 與……溝通 | communicate clearly 清晰傳達
items.distinct: connect 連結 | contact 聯繫
ex: It is essential to communicate effectively with all team members.
與所有團隊成員有效溝通至關重要。
The manager failed to communicate the changes to the staff.
主管沒有將變動事項傳達給員工。
We use digital platforms to communicate our brand values.
我們使用數位平台來傳達我們的品牌價值。

items.colloc: computer program 電腦程式 | computer science 電腦科學
items.distinct: laptop 筆記型電腦 | workstation 工作站
ex: The company provided each employee with a new computer.
公司為每位員工提供了一台新電腦。
You should back up your files on the computer daily.
你應該每天備份電腦裡的檔案。
A computer error caused a delay in processing the orders.
電腦錯誤導致訂單處理延誤。

items.colloc: continue to do something 繼續做某事 | continue with 繼續進行
items.distinct: sustain 維持 | persist 堅持
ex: We will continue to improve our services next year.
我們明年將持續改善我們的服務。
The meeting will continue after a short coffee break.
會議將在短暫的咖啡休息後繼續進行。
Does the rain continue to fall in the downtown area?
市區的雨還在持續下嗎？

items.pos: adj. 正確的 | v. 改正
items.colloc: correct answer 正確答案 | make a correction 進行修正
items.distinct: accurate 精確的 | right 正確的
ex: Please ensure that all the contact information is correct.
請確保所有的聯絡資訊都是正確的。
The editor will correct any errors in the manuscript.
編輯將會修正手稿中的任何錯誤。
It is important to provide the correct data for analysis.
提供正確的資料供分析是很重要的。

items.pos: n. 櫃檯 | v. 反擊；反駁
items.colloc: check-in counter 報到櫃檯 | over the counter 在櫃檯交易
items.distinct: desk 辦公桌 | table 桌子
ex: Please leave the documents at the front service counter.
請將文件留在前台服務櫃檯。
The lawyer tried to counter the argument presented by the witness.
律師試圖反駁證人提出的論點。
Customers are waiting at the counter to return their items.
顧客正在櫃檯等待退貨。

items.pos: adj. 每日的 | adv. 每日地 | n. 日報
items.colloc: daily routine 日常作息 | daily operation 日常營運
items.distinct: diurnal 白天的 | everyday 日常的
ex: We hold a daily meeting to discuss the project progress.
我們舉行每日會議來討論專案進度。
The company updates its website on a daily basis.
公司每天更新其網站。
Checking emails is part of my daily routine at work.
查看電子郵件是我工作日常的一部分。

items.colloc: office decoration 辦公室裝飾 | holiday decoration 節日裝飾
items.distinct: ornament 裝飾物 | furniture 家具
ex: The new office decoration makes the environment more inviting.
新的辦公室裝飾讓環境更吸引人。
They spent a lot of money on the event decoration.
他們在活動佈置上花了很多錢。
The seasonal decoration will be removed after the festival.
季節性裝飾將在節日過後拆除。

items.colloc: software developer 軟體開發人員 | property developer 房地產開發商
items.distinct: designer 設計師 | engineer 工程師
ex: The software developer fixed the bug in the new application.
軟體開發人員修復了新應用程式中的錯誤。
He works for a large real estate developer in Taipei.
他在台北一家大型房地產開發商工作。
We need another developer to join our mobile app project.
我們需要另一位開發人員加入我們的行動應用程式專案。

items.colloc: long distance 長途 | short distance 短距離
items.distinct: length 長度 | range 範圍
ex: The hotel is within walking distance of the train station.
這間飯店距離火車站僅步行可達。
Working long distance requires a reliable internet connection.
遠距工作需要穩定的網路連線。
Please keep a safe distance from the heavy machinery.
請與重型機械保持安全距離。

items.pos: adj. 垂死的；即將結束的 | v. 死（die的現在分詞）
items.colloc: dying industry 衰退產業 | dying embers 餘燼
items.distinct: dead 已死的 | deceased 已故的
ex: The company is trying to revive its dying business model.
公司正試圖重振其衰退的商業模式。
He is dedicated to saving the dying forest in the region.
他致力於拯救該地區即將消失的森林。
They are discussing the future of the dying retail sector.
他們正在討論衰退中零售業的未來。
